steps.text: write the sentence as behavior that must hold whatever the implementation, not as the mechanism that holds it today

when the code already breaks it, keep the sentence as it must hold: record a defect for each site that breaks it and escalate whether to fix them; the bullet stays a requirement until the fix, never an invariant by weakening the sentence to match the code
name the enforcement as something the instrument resolves: a bare identifier, an identifier in a file, or a module path; prose there grades not chokeable
choose the chokepoint form when one site guards the protected thing, and the totality oracle form when a detector checks the whole set; a detector is never itself the chokepoint
name the kinds honestly and answer every checklist shape printed, declared as an invariant or dismissed with a reason; leave kinds out of a bullet you did not examine, so the lack stays visible
write the because: what the invariant protects against, and what broke without it

run, then witness its refutation (the practice witness a refutation); when no test can run here (it needs a database, keys, or a running server), record unable naming the wall instead, and the bullet stays a requirement
steps.leaves: spec --check lists the bullet as an invariant, or the unable record

steps.text: stage the smallest break that changes the behavior the bullet claims, not the strings the detector reads; read the diff to confirm the edit touched only the lines you meant
refute <component>/<name> --broke "<what you changed>"; the detector fails on its own assertion, not by a hang, a kill, a timeout, or what an earlier test left behind
steps.leaves: run record for the bullet, refutation red

steps.text: restore the source byte for byte: from HEAD when the code under test is committed, and from a copy taken before the break when it is not
steps.leaves: the file matches its state before the break (git diff against HEAD, or cmp against the copy)

steps.text: run them again in one batched run confirmed with run --each, and see each green batched and alone
steps.leaves: run record for the bullets, pass; per-test run record, pass

steps.text: when the red did not come from the break, record a decision that this refutation does not count and refute again; the run store is append-only, so the correction is a later record
